an11.11:1.1: 11 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
an11.11:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.11:1.5: sambahulā kira bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.11:2.1: athakho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an11.11:2.3: sambahulā kira bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.11:2.5: tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharataṃ kena vihārena vihātabbanti.
an11.11:3.2: etaṃ kho mahānāma tumhākaṃ paṭirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ yaṃ tumhe tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyātha
an11.11:3.3: tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharataṃ kena vihārena vihātabbanti
an11.11:3.4: saddho kho mahānāma ārādhako hoti no asaddho
an11.11:3.9: imesu kho tvaṃ mahānāma pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cha dhamme uttariṃ bhāveyyāsi
an11.11:3.11: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
an11.11:3.12: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an11.11:3.13: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgataṃ ārabbha
an11.11:3.14: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an11.11:3.15: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
an11.11:3.16: ayaṃ vuccati mahānāma ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati dhammasotasamāpanno buddhānussatiṃ bhāveti.
an11.11:4.1: puna caparaṃ tvaṃ mahānāma dhammaṃ anussareyyāsi
an11.11:4.2: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti
an11.11:4.3: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an11.11:4.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti dhammaṃ ārabbha

an11.11:5.1: puna caparaṃ tvaṃ mahānāma saṃghaṃ anussareyyāsi
an11.11:5.2: supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho ujupaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho ñāyapaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho sāmīcipaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā esa bhagavato sāvakasaṃgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti
an11.11:5.3: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako saṃghaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti

an11.11:6.1: puna caparaṃ tvaṃ mahānāma attano sīlāni anussareyyāsi akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññūpasaṭṭhāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikānīti
an11.11:6.2: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako sīlaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an11.11:6.3: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti sīlaṃ ārabbha
an11.11:6.4: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an11.11:6.5: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
an11.11:6.6: ayaṃ vuccati mahānāma ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati dhammasotasamāpanno sīlānussatiṃ bhāveti.
an11.11:7.1: puna caparaṃ tvaṃ mahānāma attano cāgaṃ anussareyyāsi
an11.11:7.2: lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me
an11.11:7.3: yohaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitāya pajāya vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmi muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgaratoti
an11.11:7.4: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako cāgaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an11.11:7.5: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti cāgaṃ ārabbha
an11.11:7.6: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an11.11:7.7: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
an11.11:7.8: ayaṃ vuccati mahānāma ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati dhammasotasamāpanno cāgānussatiṃ bhāveti.
an11.11:8.1: puna caparaṃ tvaṃ mahānāma devatā anussareyyāsi
an11.11:8.2: santi devā cātummahārājikā santi devā tāvatiṃsā santi devā yāmā santi devā tusitā santi devā nimmānaratino santi devā brahmakāyikā santi devā taduttari
an11.11:8.3: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati
an11.11:8.4: yathārūpena sīlena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā mayhampi tathārūpaṃ sīlaṃ saṃvijjati
an11.11:8.5: yathārūpena sutena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā mayhampi tathārūpaṃ sutaṃ saṃvijjati
an11.11:8.6: yathārūpena cāgena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā mayhampi tathārūpo cāgo saṃvijjati
an11.11:8.7: yathārūpāya paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā mayhampi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatīti
an11.11:8.8: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca cāgañca paññañca anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an11.11:8.9: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti devatā ārabbha
an11.11:8.10: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an11.11:8.11: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati sukhino cittaṃ samādiyati
an11.11:8.12: ayaṃ vuccati mahānāma ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati sabyāpajjhāya pajāya abyāpajjho viharati dhammasotasamāpanno devatānussatiṃ bhāvetīti.
